lines.en: label mollycafe30p1:
scene mollyharukacafenight1
I wind up making it to the cafe shortly after closing as I got caught up in doing some things I don’t want to tell you about.
lines.zh: 我赶到咖啡馆时刚过打烊时间，因为之前被一些我不想告诉你的事给缠住了。

lines.en: You see, I typically show you the most important parts of my day — and those parts almost always revolve around all of the girls I’m trying to have sex with.
lines.zh: 你知道的，我通常会把我一天里最重要的部分展现给你看——而这些部分几乎总是围绕着我正努力想睡到的那些女孩。

lines.en: But sometimes, other things happen to me behind the scenes that I think it’s best to omit as they would only confuse you.
lines.zh: 但有时候，在幕后也会发生一些别的事，我觉得最好还是略过不提，因为它们只会让你困惑。

lines.en: Am I telling you the truth right now? Perhaps.
lines.zh: 我现在说的是实话吗？也许是吧。

lines.en: But who would be there to fact check me if I wasn’t?
lines.zh: 可要是我说的不是实话，又有谁会来核查呢？

lines.en: For all you know (And for all anyone else knows) this little monologue might only be a hook meant to reel you in.
lines.zh: 就你所知（也是所有其他人所知），这段小小的独白，也许不过是一枚用来把你钓上钩的钩子。

lines.en: You won’t pay attention to me throughout the mundane happenings of my life if I don’t do something to make your heart beat a little faster every now and then, right?
lines.zh: 如果我不时不时做点什么让你的心跳快上几拍，你是不会在我平淡无奇的日常里把注意力放在我身上的，对吧？

lines.en: Do you like it when I strip myself of special text?
lines.zh: 你喜欢我把那些特殊文本从自己身上剥掉吗？

lines.en: Do you like it when I make your screen flash?
lines.zh: 你喜欢我让你的屏幕闪一下吗？

lines.en: Do you like it when I lead you into dark rooms with exchange students and award you affection points under the pretense that you will use them to get your dick wet?
lines.zh: 你喜欢我把你带进有交换生的昏暗房间，再以「这些好感度能让你把鸡巴弄湿」为名赏你好感度点数吗？

lines.en: Of course you do, because you’re still here.
lines.zh: 你当然喜欢，因为你还在这里。

lines.en: Now, follow these two out into the night in hopes that it will happen once more.
lines.zh: 那么，跟着这两个人走进夜色吧，盼着这种事再多发生一次。

lines.en: If it doesn’t, you can always jerk off into a sock.
lines.zh: 要是没有，你大可以拿袜子打一发。

lines.en: - One of the narrators, or Sensei, or Selebus, or a bug, or something else, or all of those things, or you.
lines.zh: ——某位旁白，或 Sensei，或 Selebus，或一只虫子，或别的什么东西，或全部都是，或你自己。

lines.en: How does the hook feel nestled in your jaw?
lines.zh: 那枚钩子嵌在你颚骨里的感觉如何？

lines.en: : And that’s the story of when I let fifteen dudes fuck me in one night!
lines.zh: : 这就是我一晚上让十五个男人干了我的故事！

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight2
: I wish I had a penis so could fuck you toooooooo
lines.zh: : 我要是有根鸡巴就好了，这样我也能干你啊啊啊啊

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight3
scene mollyharukacafenight4
scene mollyharukacafenight1
: And that’s the story of when I solo’ed fifteen group-bosses in one night!
lines.zh: : 这就是我一晚上单刷了十五个团队副本 BOSS 的故事！

lines.en: : That’s very nice, Molly. But I would like to go home now.
lines.zh: : 真不错，Molly。不过我现在想回家了。

lines.en: : Hey. I’m here.
lines.zh: : 嘿。我来了。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight5
: Supreme Overlord? When did you come in? Actually, better question- {i}why{/i} did you come in? We’re closed. And we’ve {i}been{/i} closed for about half an hour.
lines.zh: : 至高霸主？您什么时候进来的？其实，更好的问题是——您{i}为什么{/i}进来？我们打烊了。而且{i}已经{/i}打烊半个多小时了。

lines.en: : Did Molly forget to flip the sign again?
lines.zh: : Molly 是不是又忘了翻牌子？

lines.en: : I probably forgot to flip the sign again. I tend to rush things on Fridays so I can go home and watch anime.
lines.zh: : 我大概确实是又忘了翻牌子。周五我总是赶着把事做完，好回家看动漫。

lines.en: : I didn’t really pay any attention to the sign. I just figured I was allowed in here whenever I want since I basically own the place.
lines.zh: : 我其实没怎么注意那块牌子。我只是觉得，反正这地方基本上是我的，我想什么时候进来都行。

lines.en: : But...{i}I{/i} own the place.
lines.zh: : 可是……这地方是{i}我{/i}的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but we’re best friends. Which means I pretty much own the place too.
lines.zh: : 是，可我们是最好的朋友。也就是说这地方差不多也有我一份。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight6
: We’re best friends? Since when? I thought Sara was my best friend.
lines.zh: : 我们是最好的朋友？从什么时候开始的？我还以为 Sara 是我最好的朋友。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. I get it, Sir. It’s not like hearin’ firsthand that Haruka means more to you than I do is a slap in the face or anythin’.
lines.zh: : 哦，行，我懂了，先生。亲耳听到 Haruka 在我之上，对我来说也算不上一记耳光什么的。

lines.en: : Look, you made Molly pout. Molly never pouts.
lines.zh: : 瞧，你把 Molly 惹得撅嘴了。Molly 从不撅嘴的。

lines.en: : You’re {i}both{/i} important to me.
lines.zh: : 你们两个对我来说{i}都{/i}重要。

lines.en: : It’s just that my friendship with Haruka is {i}more{/i} important because it brings me one step closer to a lifetime of free coffee. No offense, Molly.
lines.zh: : 只是我和 Haruka 的友谊{i}更{/i}重要一些，因为它让我离「一辈子免费喝咖啡」又近了一步。无意冒犯，Molly。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight7
: See, this is one more reason why my business is succeeding and Sara’s isn’t. I bet you pulled that same trick on her, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 瞧，这就是我的生意蒸蒸日上、Sara 的却每况愈下的又一个原因。我敢说你对她也耍过同一招，对吧？

lines.en: : Hey, I pay there sometimes. It’s mostly just because I feel bad, though.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我在她那儿也花钱的。不过主要还是因为我过意不去。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, Sir, if you’ve come here seeking coffee, I regret to inform you that our stock has been depleted.
lines.zh: : 很遗憾，先生，如果您是来寻咖啡的，我必须通知您，我们的库存已经见底了。

lines.en: : However, I do have a plethora of uneventful side quests I keep stashed in my back pocket for when adventurers like you are looking for something to-
lines.zh: : 不过，我后口袋里倒还揣着一大堆平淡无奇的支线任务，专门留给像您这样想找点事做的冒险者——

lines.en: : So, how are things, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 那么，最近怎么样，Haruka？

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight8
: For the love of- why doesn’t anyone ever want my quests?! It’s like the lot of you live your lives without thinking you have a hidden XP meter at the bottom of your HUD! Come on!
lines.zh: : 我的天哪——为什么就没有人想要接我的任务？！你们这些人活得像是从来没想过自己的 HUD 底下还藏着一条隐藏的经验条！拜托！

lines.en: : I mean...things are fine. Busy. Which is why I stayed and helped Molly close when I’m normally out of here by now.
lines.zh: : 我是说……还行。挺忙的。所以今天我才留下来帮 Molly 打烊，平时这个点我早走了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I stopped by the other night and this place was packed. And, I know this might be a little hard to believe, but Molly was actually {i}working{/i} that night.
lines.zh: : 是啊，前几天晚上我来过一趟，这地方挤满了人。而且，我知道这话可能有点难信，但 Molly 那天晚上居然真的{i}在工作{/i}。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight9
: You were there for that and didn’t even bother saying hello?! Am I just an NPC to you?!
lines.zh: : 您当时在场，居然连个招呼都懒得打？！对您来说我就只是个 NPC 吗？！

lines.en: : Weren’t you trying to give me a quest like, thirty seconds ago?
lines.zh: : 你三十秒前不是还想塞给我一个任务吗？

lines.en: : That-
scene mollyharukacafenight10
: Wait...maybe I {i}am{/i} an NPC. That would certainly explain why things progress for everyone else while I’m stuck here with the same habits and search history I’ve had since I was ten.
lines.zh: : 等等……也许我真{i}是{/i}个 NPC。这倒确实能解释，为什么别人都在往前走，我却困在原地，带着从十岁起就没变过的习惯和搜索记录。

lines.en: : I {i}know{/i} Molly was working that night. I thought she made a typo when she sent me the numbers after closing. I’m surprised she was able to handle that on her own.
lines.zh: : 我{i}知道{/i} Molly 那天晚上在工作。她打烊后把数字发给我时，我还以为她打错了。她居然能一个人扛下来，我很意外。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight11
: Oh, Rin was there to help. I got lucky. There’s no way-
lines.zh: : 哦，Rin 在场帮忙。我运气好。我一个人绝对——

lines.en: : Put your hands down, Molly.
lines.zh: : 把手放下来，Molly。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight12
: Theres no way I would have been able to handle that crowd on my own.
lines.zh: : 我一个人绝对应付不了那群客人。

lines.en: : Either way, you held down the fort and I’m very proud of you for that.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，你守住了店，我为你感到非常骄傲。

lines.en: : Does this mean I’m being promoted to supervisor?
lines.zh: : 这是不是意味着我要升主管了？

lines.en: : Absolutely not. But, if you don’t mind waiting an extra few hours to go home and watch anime, I wouldn’t mind buying you dinner to celebrate.
lines.zh: : 绝对没有。不过，如果你不介意晚几个小时回家看动漫，我不介意请你吃顿晚饭庆祝一下。

lines.en: : Buying me dinner? Are you...asking me out on a date?
lines.zh: : 请我吃晚饭？您是……在约我出去约会吗？

lines.en: : Would it count as a date if I invited your teacher as well?
lines.zh: : 如果我把你的老师也一起请上，这还算约会吗？

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight13
: No...but it would certainly seem like the beginning to some sort of bonus event where our dynamic as a triad changes forever.
lines.zh: : 不算……不过这看起来确实像是某种奖励事件的开端，会让我们三个人的关系从此彻底改变。

lines.en: : Molly works hard and {i}I{/i} benefit from it? Count me in.
lines.zh: : Molly 卖力干活，{i}我{/i}坐享其成？算我一个。

lines.en: : But I haven’t even said yes. There are three harems and a mech drama waiting for me in my dorm room right now.
lines.zh: : 可我都还没答应呢。我宿舍里还有三部后宫作和一部机甲剧等着我。

lines.en: : You’re that willing to just walk away from a bonus event?
lines.zh: : 你就这么舍得放弃一场奖励事件？

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight14
: Damn it, Sir! Stop using my words against me! You know bloody well I won’t be able to say no if you put it like that!
lines.zh: : 该死，先生！别拿我的话来对付我！您明知道您这么一说，我根本就拒绝不了！

lines.en: : Make the correct choices and you might even unlock a sex scene. That's how those games work, right?
lines.zh: : 只要选对选项，说不定还能解锁一场性爱场景。那些游戏就是这么运作的，对吧？

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight15
: Are you legally allowed to say that to me as my boss?
lines.zh: : 你作为我的老板，说这种话合法吗？

lines.en: : Say what? I didn’t say anything. That was Sensei.
lines.zh: : 说什么？我什么都没说。那是 Sensei 说的。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight16
: Am I legally allowed to say that as-
lines.zh: : 那我这么说合不合法——

lines.en: : Sir, if there’s anything I’ve learned from my time in dating sims, it’s that teachers can get away with anything. Games would be no fun if they were caught right before any of the CGs were unlocked.
lines.zh: : 先生，要说我在恋爱模拟游戏里学到了什么，那就是老师干什么都能全身而退。要是他们在任何 CG 解锁前就被抓了，那游戏就一点意思都没有了。

lines.en: : I picked the wrong profession.
lines.zh: : 我选错职业了。

lines.en: : I think you should agree to this dinner thing, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你应该答应这顿晚饭，Molly。

lines.en: : Not just because I want food, but because Haruka seems to be in a type of mood right now that would only boil over into something extremely destructive if you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 不只是因为我想吃东西，还因为 Haruka 现在这副心情，你要是不答应，它大概会沸腾成一锅极具破坏力的东西。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight17
: I don’t know, Sir. Wouldn’t an NPC like me just be getting in the way of your friendship with the Magistrate of Mammaries? Because it sounds like I’d just be an image variant at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，先生。像我这样的 NPC，难道不会碍着您和「巨乳司政官」的友情吗？听起来我到头来只不过是个立绘变体罢了。

lines.en: : Oh, stop. If you’re not coming, there’s no point to any of this. I have nothing to reward Sensei for and the best friend thing is only an excuse he came up with for free coffee.
lines.zh: : 行了，别说了。你要是不来，这一切就都没意义了。我也没什么可奖励 Sensei 的，而「最好的朋友」不过是他为了免费咖啡编出来的借口。

lines.en: : I don’t know...the mech anime I was talking about left off on a pretty big cliffhanger last week and I don’t want the Kendo Princess accidentally spoiling something for me again...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我说的那部机甲动漫上周停在一个相当大的悬念上，我可不想再被剑道公主不小心剧透了……

lines.en: : {i}Bonus event...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}奖励事件……{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight18
: Gaaaah, fine! Damn this completionist brain of mine!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊，好吧！都怪我这颗完美主义的脑子！

lines.en: : But I swear, if I wind up bein’ forced to hide under the bed while the two of you go at it, I’m never playin’ another visual novel again!
lines.zh: : 但我发誓，要是我最后被逼着躲在床底下看你们两个干起来，我再也不玩视觉小说了！

lines.en: scene black
Reluctant as it may be, Molly agrees to take Haruka up on her dinner offer and the three of us exit the store before heading over to the bus stop.
lines.zh: 虽然不太情愿，Molly 还是答应了 Haruka 的晚饭邀请，我们三个走出店门，朝公交站走去。

lines.en: scene nightsky
After a short drive, we’re dropped off in Haruka’s neighborhood so she won’t have to walk very far after she drinks too much and loses feeling in her legs.
lines.zh: 坐了一小段车，我们在 Haruka 家附近下车，这样等她喝多了、双腿失去知觉之后，就不用走太远。

lines.en: This is never verbalized, but I know it to be true as she has gotten hammered on several occasions now and has {i}consistently{/i} been a bad drunk.
lines.zh: 这话从没人说出口，但我知道是真的，因为她已经烂醉过好几次了，而且{i}每次{/i}醉相都很难看。

lines.en: In fact, so has Molly.
lines.zh: 事实上，Molly 也一样。

lines.en: So either tonight is going to be extremely loud and embarrassing for me-
lines.zh: 所以今晚要么会对我来说极其吵闹又丢人——

lines.en: Or I am going to get tossed into a “special bonus CG” regardless of whether I want to be or not.
lines.zh: 要么就是不管我愿不愿意，都会被扔进一张「特别奖励 CG」里。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight19
: Um...don’t you think you may have ordered a little too much wine?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你不觉得你点的酒有点太多了吗？

lines.en: : One of the bottles is for later.
lines.zh: : 其中一瓶是留着以后喝的。

lines.en: : Yeah, who am I kidding? Of course you and Sara are best friends. I’d only get in the way of your soon-to-be liver disease.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我骗谁呢？你跟 Sara 当然是最好的朋友。我只会碍着你走向那早晚要来的肝病。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight20
: I’m glad you understand.
lines.zh: : 你能明白就好。

lines.en: : Are you not going to drink, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您不喝吗，先生？

lines.en: : Are {i}you{/i} not going to drink, Molly? The waitress didn’t seem to mind that you were underage based on...well, the fact that she offered you a drink as well.
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}不喝吗，Molly？看样子服务员并不介意你未成年……嗯，光是她也给你上了酒这点就能看出来。

lines.en: : I’ve decided it’s best for everyone if I just don’t drink anymore.
lines.zh: : 我决定了，为了大家好，我以后还是不喝酒了。

lines.en: : You’re stronger than I am, Molly.
lines.zh: : 你比我坚强，Molly。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s probably for the best. I’ll hold off for tonight as well.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这样大概最好。我今晚也不喝了。

lines.en: : If it’s for my sake, Sir-
lines.zh: : 如果是因为我的话，先生——

lines.en: : I’ll hold off for tonight as well.
lines.zh: : 我今晚也不喝了。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight21
: Oh...okay.
lines.zh: : 哦……好吧。

lines.en: : Hey now, why the long face? I thought the “emotional climax of Molly MacCormack’s teenage years” or whatever it was you called it earlier had already come to an end.
lines.zh: : 嘿，怎么拉长着脸？我还以为「Molly MacCormack 青春期的情感高潮」——还是你之前管它叫什么来着——已经结束了呢。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight22
: It...It is! And my face is no longer than normal! I just...I remembered a particular scene in a show I’m watching that...evoked the...memory of a debuff I...
lines.zh: : 是……是啊！我的脸也没有比平时长！我只是……想起我正在追的一部剧里的某个场景……勾起了……一个减益效果的记忆，我……

lines.en: : Anyhow, thanks for dinner! Let’s not talk about the previous stages of an NPC’s life!
lines.zh: : 总之，谢谢您的晚饭！我们别聊 NPC 生命里的前几个阶段了！

lines.en: : How about the {i}future{/i} stages then?
lines.zh: : 那聊聊{i}未来{/i}的阶段怎么样？

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight23
: Why do we have to talk about the NPC at all when you two are clearly the playable characters here?
lines.zh: : 你们两个明显才是可操作角色，为什么非得聊 NPC 呢？

lines.en: : Because you’re {i}not{/i} an “NPC.” You’re a good girl who’s passionate about her interests and has just fallen on some hard times. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 因为你{i}不是{/i}什么「NPC」。你是个对自己的爱好充满热情的好女孩，只是碰巧遇上了一段难熬的日子。仅此而已。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight24
: That...That is perhaps the nicest thing you’ve ever said to me.
lines.zh: : 这……这大概是您对我说过最好的话了。

lines.en: : It’s probably the alcohol talking. Or the fact that this actually is a date and I’m just here as her wingman.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为酒在说话。又或者因为这其实是一场约会，而我只是在这儿当她的僚机。

lines.en: : It’s neither of those things. I can be nice sometimes too, you know. If Molly was {i}really{/i} a thorn in my side, I wouldn’t let her work for me anymore.
lines.zh: : 这两样都不是。我也是会温柔一下的，你知道吧。如果 Molly {i}真是{/i}我眼里的一根刺，我早就不让她在我这儿干了。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight25
: I’m genuinely interested in what the next stage of your life will hold. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 我是真的很好奇，你人生的下一个阶段会是什么样。我是认真的。

lines.en: : Just look at that face. She’s hitting on you right now and if you don’t pick up on that, all of those dating games were for nothing.
lines.zh: : 看看那张脸。她现在正在撩你呢，你要是连这都看不出来，那那些恋爱游戏就全白玩了。

lines.en: : The Supreme Overlord makes a valid point. You do look like you’re about ready to pounce on me. But I will give you fair warning, my stamina is far too low to be worth it right now.
lines.zh: : 至高霸主说得有道理。您看起来确实快要扑上来了。不过我先给您提个醒，我现在的耐力值实在太低，不值得您动手。

lines.en: : Molly, I’m being serious. I’m rooting for you. It’s about time you got some sort of win in life.
lines.zh: : Molly，我是认真的。我支持你。你也该在人生里赢一次了。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight26
: This sudden eruption of sentimentality is super effective and I suggest you slow down if you don’t want me fainting at the dinner table.
lines.zh: : 这股突然爆发的感伤效果拔群，我建议您稍微收着点，要是您不想我在餐桌上晕过去的话。

lines.en: : Go ahead and faint. Sensei will carry you home.
lines.zh: : 晕就晕吧。Sensei 会背你回家的。

lines.en: : Hey, don’t rope me into this. I’m just here to eat and watch you two flirt.
lines.zh: : 嘿，别把我扯进来。我只是来吃饭、看你们俩调情的。

lines.en: : Why would {i}I{/i} be the one to flirt with Molly when you’re obviously next in line for her heart now that Rin’s out of the picture?
lines.zh: : 既然 Rin 已经出局了，明摆着排队等着她芳心的人是你，{i}我{/i}干嘛还要去跟 Molly 调情？

lines.en: : Next in line? There is no queue for my feelings. This isn’t the Sims and I didn’t just go around right clicking on “flirt” with everyone in my line of sight.
lines.zh: : 排队？我的感情又不排队。这又不是《模拟人生》，我也没有到处对着视线里的每个人点右键选「调情」。

lines.en: : I’m not saying you did. But if you {i}were{/i} to pursue romance with anyone right now, who would it be?
lines.zh: : 我又没说你做了。不过如果你现在{i}要{/i}跟谁谈恋爱，那个人会是谁？

lines.en: : Haruka, you’re making her un-
lines.zh: : Haruka，你让她不自在了——

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight27
: Probably...the Herald of the Adolescents...
lines.zh: : 大概……是「青春期的先驱者」吧……

lines.en: : Bingoooo. I know my work-daughters better than anyone.
lines.zh: : 宾果。我比谁都了解我这些干女儿。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight28
: That...uhh...doesn’t mean I’m planning on moving out of the common route or anything, though! I’m just simply stating that there isn’t really anyone else {i}in{/i} the make-believe feeling queue!
lines.zh: : 那……呃……也不代表我打算走出共通路线什么的！我只是想说，在那条虚构的感情队伍{i}里{/i}，确实没有别人了！

lines.en: : And that if this were a game, which it is because everything is a game and that is why life is worth living, you would just so happen to be the closest person I have to...you know...a romance route...
lines.zh: : 而且如果这是一场游戏——它本来就是，因为一切都是游戏，而这正是人生值得活下去的理由——那么您恰好就是我手上最接近……你知道的……恋爱路线的那个人……

lines.en: : Molly-
lines.zh: : Molly——

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight29
: You don’t...have to tell me you don’t look at me that way, Sir! I’m already aware! I couldn’t be further away from your type. Just like...
lines.zh: : 您不用……不用告诉我您不是那样看我的，先生！我已经知道了！我离您的理想型远得不能再远了。就像……

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight30
: Just like...how it was for Rin...
lines.zh: : 就像……Rin 那时候一样……

lines.en: : Look what you did.
lines.zh: : 看看你干的好事。

lines.en: : Me? You’re the one who started this. I literally just said I was only here to eat and watch you two flirt.
lines.zh: : 我？明明是你挑起来的。我刚刚才说过，我只是来吃饭、看你们俩调情的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but if a girl starts getting down on herself in front of you, you’re supposed to say something. Not just sit there and let her fall deeper into the hole she’s digging.
lines.zh: : 是，可要是一个女孩在你面前开始自我贬低，你就该说点什么。而不是坐在那儿，看着她往自己挖的洞里越陷越深。

lines.en: : And {i}you’re{/i} not supposed to put people on the spot like that. What did you think was going to happen? That I’d jump over the table and kiss her?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}也不该那样把人逼到台面上。你以为会发生什么？我会翻过桌子去亲她？

lines.en: : Weird...the event’s turning sour and we didn’t even have any options to choose from...
lines.zh: : 奇怪……这个事件正在变味，而我们连一个选项都没得选……

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight31
: I’m just saying, that’s how it is for {i}everyone{/i} in your class. They {i}all{/i} feel that way about you — not just Molly. It’s obvious to anyone that you’d be next in line for her.
lines.zh: : 我只是说，你班上{i}所有人{/i}都是这样。她们{i}全都{/i}对你有那种感觉——不只是 Molly。谁都看得出来，你会是排在她心里的下一个。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean anything bad by it and I didn’t mean to put either of you on the spot. I just figured it might be a boost in confidence for her to know that the guy she’s {i}interested{/i} in is at least somewhat-
lines.zh: : 我没有恶意，也没想把你们两个任何一个逼到台面上。我只是觉得，让她知道自己{i}喜欢{/i}的男人至少还有那么一点——应该能给她增加点信心。

lines.en: : He’s not, though.
lines.zh: : 可他并没有。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight32
: Why {i}would{/i} he be?
lines.zh: : 他为什么{i}会{/i}呢？

lines.en: : What do you get for falling in love with an NPC? They never change. Their whole purpose in the game is to move the actual players forward.
lines.zh: : 爱上一个 NPC 能得到什么？她们永远不会变。她们在游戏里的全部意义，就是推动真正的玩家往前走。

lines.en: : Sir is the protagonist and I’m just a stepping stone. All that stuff about me becoming the main heroine is all talk because I know I’m not cut out for it.
lines.zh: : 先生是主角，而我只是一块垫脚石。那些「我要当上第一女主角」的话全是嘴上说说，因为我知道自己不是那块料。

lines.en: : Best chance I have is to wait for a fandisc that makes all the background girls like me more appealing to the masses.
lines.zh: : 我最大的指望，就是等出一张粉丝向特典盘，把像我这样的背景板女孩包装得讨大众喜欢些。

lines.en: : This is not the direction I was trying to lead this conversation in and I’m really sorry I brought anything up.
lines.zh: : 我本来没想把话题引到这个方向，真的很抱歉我提起了这些。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight33
: Don’t worry about it, Magistrate. You’ll not be faulted for lacking clairvoyance. There are some things about me that even you do not understand.
lines.zh: : 别放在心上，司政官。缺乏先见之明可不是您的错。关于我，有些事连您也不明白。

lines.en: : Let’s just...get back to talking about non-Molly things because Molly-{i}centric{/i} things always seem to bring everybody down! But that’s a problem with {i}her,{/i} not everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我们……还是回去聊点跟 Molly 无关的事吧，因为一切以 Molly {i}为中心{/i}的话题，好像总能让所有人心情低落！不过那是{i}她{/i}的问题，不是别人的。

lines.en: : It’s not a problem with {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这不是{i}你{/i}的问题。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight34
: You’re not doing anything wrong. You’ve never {i}been{/i} doing anything wrong.
lines.zh: : 你没有做错任何事。你{i}从来{/i}都没有做错过什么。

lines.en: : The game you’re playing is just really hard.
lines.zh: : 你正在玩的这场游戏，只是难度真的太高了。

lines.en: : You’ve got that right, Sir. I haven’t even figured out the controls yet.
lines.zh: : 您说得太对了，先生。我连操作都还没摸清呢。

lines.en: : Me neither, and you haven’t been playing even {i}half{/i} as long as I have.
lines.zh: : 我也没有，而你玩的时间连我的{i}一半{/i}都不到。

lines.en: : It’s a weird situation when {i}Haruka{/i} is the one at the table who has the most of her shit together.
lines.zh: : 一桌人里居然是 {i}Haruka{/i} 最把自己的生活收拾得井井有条，这情况可真够奇怪的。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight35
: Hey! Don’t compliment me and insult me at the same time! I don’t know how to process that!
lines.zh: : 嘿！别一边夸我一边损我！我不知道该怎么消化！

lines.en: : Perfection only exists in fan-fiction. And also Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.
lines.zh: : 完美只存在于同人小说里。还有《赛博朋克：边缘行者》里。

lines.en: : Your flaws make you beautiful, Haruka.
lines.zh: : 你的缺点让你变得美丽，Haruka。

lines.en: scene mollyharukacafenight36
: And your breasts amplify it.
lines.zh: : 而你的胸部把这份美丽放大了。

lines.en: : Oh, come on...
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托……

lines.en: : I hope to one day be as powerful as you.
lines.zh: : 我希望有一天能变得像你一样强大。

lines.en: : Yeah, we’ll see how you feel about that once the back problems start kicking in...
lines.zh: : 是吗，等你的腰开始疼了，看你还这么想不想……

lines.en: scene black
Somehow, we manage to avoid further tragedy and carry on with dinner without hurting one another again.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我们总算避免了进一步的悲剧，继续把这顿饭吃完，没有再互相伤害。

lines.en: But along the way, I realize just how endangered Molly is.
lines.zh: 但在这过程中，我意识到 Molly 有多么岌岌可危。

lines.en: For while I wasn’t looking, she got my hook caught in her mandible.
lines.zh: 因为趁我没注意，我那枚鱼钩已经勾住了她的下颌。

lines.en: And her only options at this point are to either wait for me to free her-
lines.zh: 而她此时唯一的选择，要么是等我把她放走——

lines.en: Or to be captured and consumed.
lines.zh: 要么就是被捕获、被吞吃。

lines.en: Which would you rather see?
lines.zh: 你更想看到哪一种？

lines.en: I know the answer.
lines.zh: 我知道答案。

lines.en: Because you’re the same as her.
lines.zh: 因为你和她是一样的。

lines.en: And I love the way you taste.
lines.zh: 而我喜欢你的味道。

$ molly_love += 1
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}
